speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To help me determine the cause, have you noticed any rash or spots on your body, and has anyone around you been sick with a similar illness recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Since the symptoms began after consuming ice cream, have you developed a painful, blistering rash on your lips or around your mouth, or have you noticed any swelling in your hands or feet? Please also let me know if you have experienced any vision changes.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, and Blood Cultures. REQUEST IMAGES: Please provide a full-body dermatologic examination photograph to evaluate for any rash or blistering lesions.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CBC with differential: WBC 15,000 /μL (elevated), Hemoglobin 12.5 g/dL, Platelets 200,000 /μL. Comprehensive Metabolic Panel: Within normal limits (Liver function tests: AST, ALT, Bilirubin normal). Blood Cultures: Gram-positive rods that are catalase-positive and show distinctive tumbling motility in the liquid medium. Please note: Full-body dermatologic examination photograph is not available in the provided data.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis.

The blood culture showing Gram-positive rods with tumbling motility, combined with your recent ice cream consumption and pregnancy, is highly specific for Listeria monocytogenes infection. Given your symptoms, we must immediately start treatment to protect both you and the fetus.
